name: smwgraphics-sd-hiryuu-no-ken-roseman-stage
title: SD Hiryuu no Ken - Roseman Stage
description:
This background is ripped from a game I never heard of in my life called 'SD Hiryuu no Ken' for the Super Famicom. This seems to translate to either 'SD Hiyu's Fist' or 'SD Fist of The Sun'.
Good for your city levels.
You can remove the moon for a 512x432 BG.
Enjoy!
